summary: 用 PixiJS v8 搭建和调试 2D 网页游戏渲染：异步初始化、资源加载、容器与精灵场景树、指针拖拽和 v7 到 v8 迁移。 Builds and debugs 2D browser game rendering with PixiJS v8: async init, Assets loading, the Container and Sprite scene graph, pointer dragging and v7-to-v8 migration. Use when a game or playable ad uses pixi.js, or on a blank canvas, clicks not firing, or drag stopping at the sprite edge. Not for dashboards or charts, Phaser (`phaser-core`) or 3D (`threejs-scene-setup`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill pixijs-rendering，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when a game or playable ad uses pixi.
Workflow: Read the installed version; Create, then `await app.init({...})`; Load before you build; Build the display list from `Container`s.

需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：phaser-core 用 gene_gdsk_phaser_core_v1，threejs-scene-setup 用 gene_gdsk_threejs_scene_setup_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
